title: I recorded a timelapse to show how easy it is to build awesome games in Rumpus Engine
author: Jarred-Smith
selftext: I recorded a timelapse of building a playable scene in Rumpus Engine, starting from just the default template. I think folks are having a hard time understanding the depth of what this engine can do and how easily anyone can build immediately playable games right in their browser! Would love any feedback if anyone has tried it out.

comments.author: Acceptable_Movie6712
comments.body: That’s dope. I wanna make my own engine now

replies.author: Jarred-Smith
replies.body: Thanks! You should! Rumpus Engine is open source if you want to fork it on GitHub and build on to it.

replies.author: Am094
replies.body:
Just wondering, how much $ in tokens was used to get it to this stage.

Just to satiate my curiosity :)

replies.author: Jarred-Smith
replies.body: Great question, and the honest answer is I have the max plan and by working on it as I could, I never actually went over my plan limits. So essentially I didn’t spend any additional money on tokens outside of the base plan price.

comments.author: solace1234
comments.body: I can’t imagine making a game without my own original 3d models. How does the gun work? Can you make your own models or…?

replies.author: Jarred-Smith
replies.body: You can absolutely use your own models. It just has to be a hosted .glb file that you put the URL into the props section in the engine. You can also use your own models for guns and assign animations for reloads.

replies.author: solace1234
replies.body:
Nice! Then I assume I can add my own textures too, though a lot of the preset stuff does look pretty good.

This might be a silly question, perhaps too complicated to answer and i should just find out myself, but… how does the engine know where the bullets are coming from if i upload my own model? 

In fact I have a ton of questions about how animations work and NPC behavior and pretty much every facet, so i should just try it out. How long did you spend on this? Would you say an open-world RPG with dialogue options is possible in this?

replies.author: Jarred-Smith
replies.body:
Yes, you can upload your own textures as well. No silly questions! Here’s the full manual that breaks down everything in the editor by section: https://rumpusengine.com/breach-help.html

I think that will answer most of your questions, and of course, just get in there and play with it. Happy to help if you have any other questions!

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body:
Is it built for fps, or can it handle different kinds of games, such as top down twin stick shooters, arpgs, strategy games?
Also, can it use gaussian splats?

replies.author: Jarred-Smith
replies.body: You can build fps, tps, twin stick, top down , sidescroll etc. there are multiple game options in the gameplay settings on the editor that allow more control over each game type. It does doesn’t have Gaussian splat abilities at the moment, but good feature!
